title: My Art Class
text: Every Monday, I have art class at school. I take out my crayons, markers, and paint. Today, we use a brush and paint to make a picture on canvas. My friend likes to use clay to make a small cup. After that, we use scissors and glue to make a craft. I put a colorful sticker on my paper at the end. Art is my favorite class of the week!
